gloss: to have trouble; to quarrel; to dispute

definitions.gloss: to have trouble; to quarrel; to dispute; to have a conflict
definitions.explanation: For people or parties to have disagreements or conflicts. Often used for disputes over money, inheritance, or interpersonal conflicts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遺産|いさん}→遺産：14405_isan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揉|も}め→揉む：00289_momu⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The siblings are fighting over the inheritance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{揉|も}め→揉む：00289_momu⟧た。
examples.english: We had a dispute with the neighbors over noise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{揉|も}め→揉む：00289_momu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{円満|えんまん}→円満：17922_enman⟧⟦{退社|たいしゃ}→退社：06156_taisha⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to leave the company amicably without any conflict.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). Related transitive form: ⟦{揉|も}む→揉む：00289_momu⟧ (to massage; to rub).

USAGE:
{揉|も}める specifically refers to interpersonal or inter-party conflicts and disputes. Common contexts include:
- ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{揉|も}める - to fight over money
- ⟦{遺産|いさん}→遺産：14405_isan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{揉|も}める - to dispute over inheritance
- ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{揉|も}める - to have conflicts during divorce

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{揉|も}める (to have a dispute with ~)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{揉|も}める (to fight over ~)
- ⟦{揉|も}め{事|ごと}→揉め事：08361_momegoto⟧ (trouble, dispute - noun form)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{揉|も}め{事|ごと}→揉め事：08361_momegoto⟧ - trouble, dispute
- ⟦{揉|も}め→揉む：00289_momu⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ - to struggle/scuffle together

REGISTER:
Casual to neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
